data_fields.name: recipe_difficulty
data_fields.donor_constant: per recipe row (Difficulty field of the recipe table)

best_idea: Salvage turns a taken piece into material units in proportion to skill times the piece's quality, stores them in per-material bags with a fixed capacity that open a new bag when full, and raises the bag's value with skill.
decision_why: Fits take-one loot: a taken piece becomes a material ledger row with a checkable yield formula and capped bags. Adapt: fix the workmanship double count on overflow and choose a policy that keeps overflow units instead of the retail loss.
acceptance: Server test: a quality 4.5 piece salvaged at skill 300 with no augments yields 7 units; a bag fills at 100 and a new bag opens for the rest; a piece split across two bags adds its quality to each in proportion to the units placed.
